purpose: Choose the next scope-preserving recursive framing operation after every accepted incremental scratchpad index.
source: User's four-frame, two-reference, narrative-expansion design with five unrestricted positions.
layout: Indices 3*d, 3*d+1 and 3*d+2 respectively anchor/transfer R-A, anchor/transfer R-B, and expand the enclosing narrative for frame d. Indices 12 through 16 remain freely authored.
selection_method: Deterministic per-comment SHA-256 mapping; no agent-selected operator and no semantic correctness judgment by the workflow.

enclosing_actions.action: an enclosing speaker attributes the inner account to its source
an enclosing speaker recalls the inner account without adopting its claims
an enclosing speaker questions the inner account while preserving attribution
an enclosing author records the inner account as reported
an enclosing speaker interprets the inner account while retaining its original speakers
an enclosing speaker discusses the account in a broader setting

constraints: Each accepted revision is a single root JSON array and adds exactly one scratchpad wrapper at its next zero-based index.
Preserve all previously accepted entries without edits; keep references R-A and R-B distinct through the four frames.
An enclosing statement about an inner claim must not silently become a direct assertion that the inner claim is true.
Each narrative expansion adds new substantive content rather than merely paraphrasing the preceding frame.
No semantic compliance checker is asserted: the workflow checks structural validity and retains complete diagnostic evidence.
After index 16, freeze progression and keep JSON validation active.
delivery: Persist next_function as a JSON object in comment state, record an instruction JSON object in the workspace, and publish/update a source-linked controller comment on Issue #1. This publishes instructions; an external agent still must act on them.
